Keep everything. Finish the interface, the feedback and check the template. Add these sections to game_spec.json:
{"text":{"controlsKeyboard":"Arrows: move - Space: pick - Arrow: swap","controlsTouch":"Swipe a tile, or tap two neighbours","moves":"Moves","goalScore":"Reach","goalCovers":"Clear covers","levelClear":"Level clear!","win":"All levels clear!","lose":"Out of moves","shuffle":"No moves left: shuffling"}}

HUD (anchored to visible screen edges + safe margin)
- Top-left: run score (large), level "L2/4" below.
- Top-center: goal panel: text.goalScore with a progress bar (level score / target), or text.goalCovers with the remaining covers count; moves left below in large digits, hazard color when 3 or less.
- Top-right: pause button. Nothing at the bottom.
Rebuild HUD strings only when values change.

SCREENS
- Title: small static 6x6 board in the background, title, best score, highest level reached, control hints text.controlsKeyboard / text.controlsTouch (highlight the last input type), text.tapToStart.
- LEVEL_CLEAR: text.levelClear, unused-move bonus counted up, Next button (confirm). Not a RESULT: no sendScore.
- Result: text.win or text.lose, score, best with "New best!", level reached, Play again and Menu.

FEEDBACK AND SOUND (style.feedback, audio.sfx)
- Select: tile scale 1.1 + player outline, uiTap. Swap: swap sound.
- Invalid swap: tween back + small shake of both tiles, invalid sound.
- Match: tiles shrink to 0, burst in the tile color, "+N" popup at the group center, match sound with pitch x (1 + 0.12 x depth).
- Cascade depth >= 1: "x1.5" style popup in special color.
- Bonus created or triggered: cell flash, line or ring sweep, bonus sound.
- Cover layer removed: a layer dot disappears, line-colored burst, cover sound.
- Shuffle: tiles fade out and in, shuffle sound. Level clear and win: win sound; lose: lose sound.
- Hint: the two tiles pulse (scale 1 +/- 0.08 at 2 Hz).

DEBUG OVERLAY (when debug.showFps)
FPS, turn state, cascade depth, valid moves count, particles in use.

ACCEPTANCE CHECK (fix anything that fails, then report)
1. Swap works by swipe, mouse drag, tap-tap and keyboard (cursor + Space + arrow); cursor shown after a key press.
2. Invalid swap reverts without spending a move; select/swap ignored during the system turn.
3. New boards never start with a match and always have a valid move; deadlock triggers a shuffle.
4. line4 makes lineClear, LT makes bomb, line5 makes colorBomb; effects chain; colorBomb swap clears a type.
5. Covers hide and lock tiles, lose one layer per adjacent match, reveal the tile at 0; holes and covers split gravity.
6. Cascade multiplier applied and capped. Score goal and covers goal both clear a level; out of moves loses; last level wins.
7. Score shown = value sent with sendScore = best saved; highestLevel saved.
8. Changing cols/rows/layout of a level in game_spec.json changes the board; 6x6 to 9x9 fit at 9:32, 9:16, 1:1, 16:9 and 32:9.
9. No value hard-coded outside game_spec.json, no console errors, no network requests, at least 30 FPS during big chains.
List the game_spec.json keys you added in this step, if any.
